name: jedinstveni matični broj (matični broj)
issuer: the Ministry of Internal Affairs (MUP), in the Central Population Register
note: Paragraf.me (4 December 2019, trade press reprinting the Ministry of Internal Affairs' statement to RTCG of 29 November 2019; the Law on the Central Population Register itself, Sl. list RCG 49/2007 as amended by Sl. list CG 41/2010, 40/2011 and 55/2016, wasn't found in its official text today): under that Law the matični broj has 13 digits in six groups: the day, month and year of birth, the register number, a combination of digits marking sex and serial number, and a control number; it is determined ex officio by the child's place of birth, the person's residence when it is determined, or the place of entry in the register of births where the person has no residence in Montenegro; a child of Montenegrin citizens born abroad is given one on entry in the register of births; a person may hold only one. Read as given at birth (entry in the register of births), to citizens and residents. The pattern holds day (01 to 31) and month (01 to 12) and nine more digits; the year's three digits, the register areas (the Rulebook, Sl. list CG 15/2008, not read) and the control digit's rule aren't held. No fee or time is stated, nor what needs it.

sources.title: Paragraf.me, ZAKON O CENTRALNOM REGISTRU STANOVNIŠTVA: Za svaki zahtjev za promjenu matičnog broja vodi se upravni postupak (4 December 2019)
sources.said: propisano da se matični broj sastoji od 13 cifara, svrstanih u šest grupa. ... Te grupe čine dan, mjesec i godina rođenja, broj registra, kombinacija cifara kojima se označava pol i redni broj, i kontrolni broj. ... matični broj određuje po službenoj dužnosti, prema mjestu rođenja djeteta, prebivalištu osoba u trenutku određivanja matičnog broja ... U postupku upisa u matični registar rođenih, djetetu se shodno zakonu određuje matični broj ... osoba može imati samo jedan matični broj sa kojim se služi.
